summary: This 6-K filing reports the vesting of conditional share awards under the Smith & Nephew Global Share Plan 2020 for a PDMR, with a subsequent sale of shares to cover tax obligations. The transaction occurred on May 19, 2026 on the London Stock Exchange. The vesting is a routine equity compensation event; no price, premium, or advisor is involved. This is a standard disclosure under UK Market Abuse Regulation, mapped to a US vesting notification. There is no special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, or corporate action. What to watch: none; this is a routine insider transaction.
